title: Measure what each review round catches, then propose models and prompts per round
why: Owner question on item 356, 13:41 CST Nov 7: "should we also consider reworking our 3 round program in terms of what models they use what prompts etc?" Answered yes in the item's reply.
note: First measure, from review records: the findings per round, and how many were real. Then propose a model and prompt per round. A change to rule roles-review-cap-three or agent-model-cap needs the owner's word. 13:45 CST: the coordinator's read-only audit agent is measuring past rounds (verdict, model, and how often findings came back). 13:51 CST: the audit is done. Its three choices are page item 359. Owner, item 359, 14:41 CST: a, b and c: round 1 on Sonnet for guard and check diffs; skip round 3 unless the change touches a guard or check or round 2 failed; label findings blocker, should-fix or wording, and only a blocker FAILs.
